title: Lists of Returned Exiles

questions.question: Who did Nehemiah put in charge of Jerusalem?
options: Hanani my brother and Hananiah the governor of the castle
questions.correctAnswer: Hanani my brother and Hananiah the governor of the castle
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:2 (ESV): "I gave my brother Hanani and Hananiah the governor of the castle charge over Jerusalem..."

questions.question: Why was Hananiah chosen?
options: He was a more faithful and God-fearing man than many
questions.correctAnswer: He was a more faithful and God-fearing man than many
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:2 (ESV): "...for he was a more faithful and God-fearing man than many."

questions.question: When were the gates of Jerusalem to be opened?
options: Not until the sun is hot
questions.correctAnswer: Not until the sun is hot
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:3 (ESV): "...Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot..."

questions.question: What did God put into Nehemiah's heart to do?
options: Enroll the nobles, officials, and people by genealogy
questions.correctAnswer: Enroll the nobles, officials, and people by genealogy
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:5 (ESV): "Then my God put it into my heart to assemble the nobles and the officials and the people to be enrolled by genealogy."

questions.question: What was the total number of the whole assembly?
How many singing men and women were there?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:67 (ESV): "...and they had 245 singing men and singing women."

questions.question: What happened to the priests who could not prove their genealogy?
options: They were excluded from the priesthood as unclean
questions.correctAnswer: They were excluded from the priesthood as unclean
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:64 (ESV): "...so they were excluded from the priesthood as unclean."

questions.question: Who gave to the treasury for the work?
options: Some of the heads of fathers' houses, the governor, and the rest of the people
questions.correctAnswer: Some of the heads of fathers' houses, the governor, and the rest of the people
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:70-71 (ESV): "Now some of the heads of fathers' houses gave to the work. The governor gave..."

questions.question: Where were the people living at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:73 (ESV): "...So the priests... and all Israel lived in their towns."

questions.question: Who was the governor mentioned in the giving list?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:70 (ESV): "The governor gave to the treasury..." (Nehemiah is the Tirshatha/governor).

questions.question: How much gold did the governor give?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:70 (ESV): "...1,000 darics of gold, 50 basins, 30 priests' garments, and 500 minas of silver."

questions.question: Who were the porters mentioned?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:1 (ESV): "Now when the wall had been built... and the gatekeepers... had been appointed..."

questions.question: What specific instruction was given about the guards?
options: Appoint guards from among the inhabitants of Jerusalem, some at their guard posts and some in front of their own homes
questions.correctAnswer: Appoint guards from among the inhabitants of Jerusalem, some at their guard posts and some in front of their own homes
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 7:3 (ESV): "...Appoint guards from among the inhabitants of Jerusalem..."

key_verse_text: I gave my brother Hanani and Hananiah the governor of the castle charge over Jerusalem, for he was a more faithful and God-fearing man than many.
